name: Create an evaluator in the authenticated project
description: Create an evaluator in the authenticated project Create an evaluator in the authenticated project. POST /api/public/v2/evaluators
context:
POST /api/public/v2/evaluators
Create an evaluator in the authenticated project. An evaluator defines **how** Langfuse should score data. LLM-as-a-judge evaluators define a prompt, expected structured output, and optional model configuration. Code evaluators define source code and a runtime language. This always creates a new evaluator with version `1`. Names are not identifiers and do not need to be unique.
Required: body (body)

name: List evaluators in newest-first creation order
description: List evaluators in newest-first creation order List evaluators in newest-first creation order. GET /api/public/v2/evaluators
context:
GET /api/public/v2/evaluators
List evaluators in newest-first creation order. Every evaluator includes its latest definition and version metadata flattened into the evaluator object, plus associated evaluation rules. Treat the cursor as opaque and return it unchanged.
Optional: limit (query) — Maximum number of items to return. Defaults to `50` and cannot exceed `100`.; cursor (query) — Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

name: List an evaluator's version history in newest-first order
description: List an evaluator's version history in newest-first order List an evaluator's version history in newest-first order. GET /api/public/v2/evaluators/{evaluatorId}/versions
context:
GET /api/public/v2/evaluators/{evaluatorId}/versions
List an evaluator's version history in newest-first order. This endpoint is intended for history and audit use cases. Ordinary clients can use the flattened `version` and definition fields on the evaluator response.
Required: evaluatorId (path) — Stable evaluator identifier returned by the evaluator endpoints.
Optional: limit (query) — Maximum number of versions to return. Defaults to `50` and cannot exceed `100`.; cursor (query) — Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.
